races.name: Racing Foundation Supports The NHC EBF Maiden Stakes (GBB/IRE Incentive Race)
Sir Peter O'Sullevan Charitable Trust Supports NHC EBF Novice Stakes (GBB/GBBPlus Race)

runners_data.name: Night Wolf
runners_data.note: Returns from 184-day break but showed promise when third over course and distance on good going previously

runners_data.name: Why Not Win
runners_data.note: Lightly raced and unexposed with top jockey McDonald taking the ride, though running style unknown creates tactical uncertainty

runners_data.name: Infraad
runners_data.note: Consistent prominent runner with RPR advantage, proven on good going and represents powerful Haggas/Marquand combination

runners_data.name: Asia Force
runners_data.note: Confirmed front runner who can dictate from the start, recent seconds suggest he's knocking on the door

runners_data.name: Sea Lantern
runners_data.note: Hold-up specialist returning from 240-day absence but has winning form over 12f on soft going

runners_data.name: Leighton
runners_data.note: Back-marker from powerful Gosden yard but needs significant improvement after disappointing recent runs

races.paceDynamic: Asia Force will lead from the start with no other confirmed front runners to challenge his position. Night Wolf and Infraad will track in behind as the prominent runners, while Sea Lantern and Leighton sit at the back as hold-up horses. With Asia Force able to dictate terms without pressure, he can set a sustainable gallop that will make life difficult for the closers on Pontefract's turning track. This race shape strongly favours front runners and prominent racers who can stay close to the pace.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Asia Force Controls
scenarios.trigger: If Asia Force gets an uncontested lead and maintains his recent form
scenarios.body: He can kick clear turning for home before the hold-up horses get into gear. The sustainable pace he sets will blunt the finishing kicks of Sea Lantern and Leighton who need a stronger gallop.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent Pair Strike
scenarios.trigger: If Night Wolf or Infraad can improve past Asia Force in the straight
scenarios.body: Their handy positions allow them to strike when Asia Force weakens, getting first run on the hold-up horses. The class edge of Infraad or potential improvement from Night Wolf after a break could prove decisive.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horse Charges
scenarios.trigger: If the pace becomes too slow or the prominent horses weaken significantly
scenarios.body: Sea Lantern's proven winning form over 12f and Leighton's Gosden training could see them finish strongly. However, they need everything to fall right from their back positions on this turning track.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Unknown Quantity Wins
scenarios.trigger: If Why Not Win shows significant improvement from his lightly-raced profile
scenarios.body: McDonald's booking for Johnston suggests confidence in this unexposed runner. His unknown running style could be the key tactical advantage if the others fight out predictable positions.

watchPoints.text: Asia Force must be monitored early - if he gets a soft lead he becomes very dangerous given his front-running style
Watch Why Not Win's position in the early stages as his unknown running style could disrupt the expected pace scenario
Sea Lantern needs to be closer than usual given the likely modest pace that won't suit his hold-up style
Night Wolf's fitness after 184-day break is crucial - any signs of rustiness early will end his chances
Track Infraad's position behind the leaders as he needs to be handy enough to strike when Asia Force weakens

races.name: NARS Supports The National Horseracing College Handicap

runners_data.name: Keldeo
runners_data.note: Prominent style suits perfectly, good recent 5f form and Ryan Russell handles Pontefract well

runners_data.name: Alpine Girl
runners_data.note: Hold-up style faces tactical disadvantage on sharp track, headgear suggests connections seeking improvement

runners_data.name: General Assembly
runners_data.note: Prominent runner ideally placed but 62-day break and zero recent wins are concerns

runners_data.name: Call To Action
runners_data.note: Natural front runner with course winner credentials, 296-day absence either masterstroke or major worry

runners_data.name: Jojo Rabbit
runners_data.note: Versatile prominent runner in excellent form with 3lb claimer, strong recent 5f win at Ripon

runners_data.name: Toomuchforme
runners_data.note: Prominent style fits race shape, solid recent 5f form and useful 3lb apprentice allowance

runners_data.name: Rock Of England
runners_data.note: Hold-up style poorly suited to likely pace scenario despite solid recent course form

runners_data.name: Invincible Crown
runners_data.note: Hold-up runner facing uphill task, 142-day break adds further complexity to tactical challenge

races.paceDynamic: Call To Action will be the sole early leader from stall position, with a cluster of prominent runners including Keldeo, General Assembly, Jojo Rabbit and Toomuchforme tracking close behind. The pace will be genuine but not suicidal over this sharp 5f at Pontefract, as Call To Action won't face immediate pressure for the lead. Alpine Girl, Rock Of England and Invincible Crown must overcome their hold-up styles on a track that typically favours those able to race prominently. This race shape clearly favours prominent runners who can sit close to Call To Action and strike in the final furlong.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Prominent Runners Dominate
scenarios.trigger: If Call To Action sets sustainable fractions without early pressure
scenarios.body: The pace will be honest but not punishing, allowing the prominent pack to travel comfortably before unleashing finishing kicks. Keldeo and Jojo Rabbit are perfectly positioned to exploit this tactical setup.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Front Runner Wire-to-Wire
scenarios.trigger: If Call To Action gets soft sectionals and kicks clear turning for home
scenarios.body: The long absence could work in Call To Action's favour if allowed easy sectionals, building an unassailable lead before the prominent pack can respond. Michael & David Easterby's 296-day freshen-up suggests they've been targeting this spot.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horse Charges
scenarios.trigger: If the early pace becomes too strong between Call To Action and the prominent group
scenarios.body: A fierce early gallop would set up Alpine Girl or Rock Of England to deliver late swoops from the rear. However, Pontefract's sharp nature makes this recovery mission extremely difficult over 5f.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace Collapse Surprise
scenarios.trigger: If Call To Action stops quickly and the prominent pack comes back to the field
scenarios.body: A dramatically slow pace could bring the entire field into contention in the final 2f. This would create a sprint finish where class and recent form become decisive factors.

watchPoints.text: Call To Action's market support after 296 days off will reveal if connections expect instant sharpness
Jojo Rabbit's early position crucial as experienced campaigner could overrace if trapped wide
Alpine Girl's headgear change suggests frustration with recent efforts, barrier draw impacts hold-up chances
General Assembly needs to break sharply to secure prominent position, Sean Bowen's urgency from stalls key
Toomuchforme's apprentice jockey must judge pace perfectly to avoid being caught wide in large field

races.name: Tuffa Boots Supports The National Horseracing College Handicap

runners_data.name: Billyb
runners_data.note: Hold-up specialist returning after 159 days absence but has solid course record and suits the expected pace scenario

runners_data.name: Garden Oasis
runners_data.note: Sole leader will dictate terms but 11-year-old legs may not sustain kick when challenged by fresher rivals

runners_data.name: Sailthisshipalone
runners_data.note: Prominent runner in good form but George Wood booking suggests they expect traffic problems from the draw

runners_data.name: Walsingham
runners_data.note: Class act who can position handily and has Daniel Tudhope's tactical nous to find the right moment to strike

runners_data.name: Cosmos Raj
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse returning after 208 days but claims 5lbs and trainer O'Meara hits form at the right time

runners_data.name: Leadenhall
runners_data.note: Another hold-up type who benefits from the congestion ahead and has strong course form for Tim Easterby

runners_data.name: On The River
runners_data.note: Prominent style suits but has been flattered by soft opposition recently and faces stiffer test here

runners_data.name: Sir Paul Ramsey
runners_data.note: Handy type who can race prominently but Tom Marquand may need to be creative to avoid the traffic jam

runners_data.name: Vincent Rocks
runners_data.note: Prominent runner who can sit closer than usual given the steady pace and has class edge on ratings

races.paceDynamic: Garden Oasis will lead uncontested early, setting a steady gallop that suits his veteran style. Behind him, five horses (Sailthisshipalone, Walsingham, On The River, Sir Paul Ramsey, Vincent Rocks) will jostle for prominent positions, creating inevitable traffic problems turning for home. The hold-up brigade of Billyb, Cosmos Raj and Leadenhall will rely on gaps appearing in the straight. This controlled pace followed by prominent congestion strongly favours the patient hold-up horses who can pick their way through late.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horse Strikes
scenarios.trigger: If Garden Oasis sets moderate fractions and the prominent group gets tangled up
scenarios.body: The pace will be honest enough to set up a closer, and Billyb or Leadenhall can exploit the traffic problems ahead. Fresh legs prevail when others have been scrapping for position.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent Escape Traffic
scenarios.trigger: If one of the prominent runners secures a clean run approaching the final furlong
scenarios.body: Walsingham or On The River can capitalize on their handiness while others are still finding daylight. Good positioning trumps pure finishing kick in a bunched finish.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Garden Oasis Wire Job
scenarios.trigger: If the early leader maintains his rhythm and the chasers cancel each other out
scenarios.body: The 11-year-old's experience pays dividends as he holds on grimly while fresher horses waste energy in traffic behind. Sometimes the simple tactics work best.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace Collapses Early
scenarios.trigger: If Garden Oasis goes too slow and gets swamped by the prominent pack turning in
scenarios.body: The race becomes a sprint from the 2f pole with no gaps appearing for the hold-up horses. Raw speed matters more than tactical positioning in a cavalry charge finish.

watchPoints.text: Garden Oasis early fractions - if he goes too fast he stops, too slow and gets swamped by the prominent pack
Traffic problems 2f out when Walsingham, On The River, Sailthisshipalone and Sir Paul Ramsey converge on limited racing room
Billyb's jumping ability after 159-day break - needs to be sharp to exploit the pace setup
David O'Meara's double-handed approach with Walsingham prominent and Cosmos Raj held up suggests confident stable
Tim Easterby runners Garden Oasis and Leadenhall representing different tactical approaches from the same shrewd handler

races.name: HBLB Supports The National Horseracing College Handicap

runners_data.name: Sixtygeesbaby
runners_data.note: Prominent style suits but Daniel Tudhope may need to be more aggressive early given the lack of pace setters.

runners_data.name: Veblen Good
runners_data.note: Front-running style with Cian Horgan's 5lb claim could prove decisive if allowed easy lead after 236-day absence.

runners_data.name: The Good Biscuit
runners_data.note: Hold-up specialist with excellent recent form whose 127lbs bottom weight significantly aids closing chances.

runners_data.name: Modern Times
runners_data.note: Strong closer carrying minimum weight who showed good form last time and benefits from David Allan's experience.

runners_data.name: Mystical Storm
runners_data.note: Hold-up runner returning from 186-day break may need the outing despite Julie Camacho's solid strike rate.

runners_data.name: Alpha Magic
runners_data.note: Back-runner with proven finishing kick but faces fitness test after 282 days away from action.

races.paceDynamic: Veblen Good will take the field along from the front with minimal early pressure, as Sixtygeesbaby is the only other prominent runner and may sit just behind rather than engage immediately. The moderate early gallop will allow the hold-up quartet of The Good Biscuit, Modern Times, Mystical Storm, and Alpha Magic to stay in touch through the first half of this straight six furlongs. With no genuine speed horses to inject serious tempo, the pace will build gradually rather than create a searching test from the outset. This tactical setup strongly favours the closers who can use their finishing kicks in the final two furlongs when the tempo eventually lifts.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Sustained Closer Kick
scenarios.trigger: If Veblen Good sets steady fractions and the hold-up horses get ideal positioning
scenarios.body: The patient tactics allow the quartet of back-runners to unleash their finishing speed when it matters most. Modern Times and The Good Biscuit are perfectly suited to capitalize on this tactical development with their proven closing ability.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Front Runner Controls
scenarios.trigger: If Veblen Good finds an easy lead and quickens decisively at the two-furlong pole
scenarios.body: The David O'Meara-trained gelding gets first run on his rivals and builds an insurmountable advantage. His ability to control the tempo from the front gives him the tactical edge over horses who need to make up ground.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Early Pace Injection
scenarios.trigger: If Sixtygeesbaby takes on Veblen Good early or someone else shows unexpected speed
scenarios.body: The increased tempo stretches the field and creates gaps for strong finishers to exploit late. Alpha Magic and Modern Times benefit most from this searching test that exposes any fitness doubts.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Tactical Muddle
scenarios.trigger: If the moderate pace leads to a bunch finish with multiple horses challenging simultaneously
scenarios.body: The lack of early pace creates a cavalry charge where positioning and luck become crucial factors. Any of the hold-up horses could prevail if they secure a clear passage in the final furlong.

watchPoints.text: Modern Times could be underestimated at the weights given his strong closing kick and light impost of 125lbs
Veblen Good's 236-day layoff combined with apprentice jockey creates uncertainty about readiness for immediate success
The Good Biscuit's recent winning form and minimum weight makes him dangerous if getting clear passage late
Alpha Magic faces serious fitness questions after nearly ten months off the track despite obvious talent
Sixtygeesbaby may be forced into unwanted early tactics if no other horse wants to press Veblen Good

races.name: Chadwick Lawrence Supports National Horseracing College Handicap

runners_data.name: Piecederesistance
runners_data.note: Confirmed leader returning after 270 days with tongue-tie applied, faces inevitable pressure from superior-rated closers in straight

runners_data.name: Bearwith
runners_data.note: Classic hold-up horse in excellent recent form with 11-day turnaround, perfectly suited to tactical pace scenario

runners_data.name: Lightening Company
runners_data.note: Recent Southwell winner dropping back in trip, apprentice jockey reduces weight but trainer struggling for winners

runners_data.name: Finlaggan
runners_data.note: Four-year-old who typically fades in finish according to spotlight, making him vulnerable despite O'Meara's stable form

runners_data.name: Dubawi Time
runners_data.note: Prominent runner returning after 205 days with significant weight advantage, headgear applied suggests connections seek improvement

runners_data.name: Heartened
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse with solid recent placings, benefits from tactical pace but lacks winning form on similar going

races.paceDynamic: Piecederesistance will lead from flag to finish as the only confirmed front runner in this small field, setting a sustainable tempo without pressure. Dubawi Time may track in second early, but the lack of genuine pace angles means this becomes a tactical affair. The moderate early gallop will create bunching into the straight, where the quartet of hold-up horses (Bearwith, Lightening Company, Finlaggan, Heartened) will unleash their finishing kicks. This race shape strongly favours horses with proven finishing speed who can quicken from off the pace.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Hold-up horses dominate
scenarios.trigger: If Piecederesistance sets a steady tempo and the field bunches turning for home
scenarios.body: The tactical nature allows closers to position perfectly and unleash superior finishing kicks in the final two furlongs. Bearwith and Lightening Company benefit most from their recent winning form and proven ability to quicken.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Front runner survives
scenarios.trigger: If Piecederesistance kicks clear approaching the final furlong and the closers respond too late
scenarios.body: The uncontested lead proves decisive on this tight track, though Bearwith's superior class threatens late. Piecederesistance's 270-day break becomes less relevant if he gets first run.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Prominent tracker strikes
scenarios.trigger: If Dubawi Time stalks the leader and produces his finishing kick before the hold-up horses can respond
scenarios.body: The 7lb weight advantage and tactical position allow Dubawi Time to bridge the gap between pace and closers. His recent RPR of 79 suggests he retains ability despite the long absence.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Surprise closer emerges
scenarios.trigger: If Finlaggan or Heartened produce career-best efforts from their lower ratings
scenarios.body: The tactical pace allows a perfectly-timed run from deep to catch the fancied runners napping. Youth advantage for both four-year-olds in this veteran field.

watchPoints.text: Watch Piecederesistance early - if he breaks slowly or gets headed, his chance disappears given the long layoff
Monitor Bearwith's position turning for home - needs clear room to unleash his finishing kick from hold-up style
Observe Lightening Company's settling - if he races keenly behind the slow pace, it will compromise his finishing effort
Check Finlaggan's response when pressure builds - his tendency to fade makes him vulnerable if the pace quickens
Note Dubawi Time's jumping and early position - needs to track the leader closely to utilise his weight advantage

races.name: Yorkshire Society Supports The National Horseracing College Handicap

runners_data.name: Powerful Response
runners_data.note: Prominent runner who has been consistent in similar company but may lack the acceleration to quicken decisively off a steady pace

runners_data.name: Volenti

runners_data.name: Star Start
runners_data.note: Natural front-runner who should get an easy lead but may struggle to repel late challengers given recent form suggests stamina limitations

runners_data.name: We've Got This
runners_data.note: Strong stayer returning from a 222-day break with excellent course record, perfectly suited to come from behind in a slowly-run race

runners_data.name: How's The Guvnor
runners_data.note: Versatile prominent runner in good current form whose tactical speed could prove decisive if positioned close enough to the pace

runners_data.name: Boubyan
runners_data.note: Progressive type whose hold-up style matches the likely race shape, with Michael Appleby's 4/26 record and 11-day freshening both positive angles

runners_data.name: Al Baahy
runners_data.note: Improved performer at this level carrying bottom weight, whose hold-up style fits perfectly but needs to overcome very modest recent efforts

runners_data.name: Bun Bang Fai
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse returning from a long break with headgear changes suggesting connections are trying to find improvement

runners_data.name: Token Love
runners_data.note: Prominent runner whose style may be compromised if the pace becomes too slow for his finishing kick to be effective

runners_data.name: Rajawail
runners_data.note: Bottom-weighted hold-up performer whose 7-day turnaround and massive weight advantage create upset potential in the right circumstances

races.paceDynamic: Star Start is the sole confirmed front-runner and will dictate terms from the outset, likely to get an uncontested lead given the lack of other early pace. With Powerful Response, How's The Guvnor and Token Love settling prominently behind, the early gallop will be steady rather than demanding. The majority of the field including We've Got This, Volenti, Boubyan and Al Baahy will track from mid-division or further back, creating a compressed field turning for home. This sustainable pace scenario heavily favours hold-up horses who can unleash late kicks, as the early leaders will be sitting ducks in the final furlong.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horses Dominate
scenarios.trigger: If Star Start gets an easy lead and the pace stays modest through halfway
scenarios.body: The lack of early pressure allows closers to wind up with devastating effect, sweeping past tiring leaders. We've Got This and Boubyan are perfectly positioned to exploit this tactical advantage.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent Tracker Strikes
scenarios.trigger: If How's The Guvnor or Powerful Response can stalk the leader without overexerting
scenarios.body: They get first run on the weakening Star Start while the hold-up brigade still have ground to make up. The tactical positioning proves crucial in a tightly-run finish.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Star Start Wires Field
scenarios.trigger: If the leader kicks clear turning for home before the closers can organise
scenarios.body: The 11-day break has freshened Star Start who exploits the tactical advantage of an uncontested lead. Ruth Carr's 5/31 strike rate suggests the stable is in good form.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Rajawail Spring Surprise
scenarios.trigger: If the pace collapses completely and the 116lb weight advantage becomes decisive
scenarios.body: The massive weight pull combined with PJ McDonald's booking creates an unlikely but possible upset scenario. Faye McManoman's 7-day turnaround suggests connections are confident.

watchPoints.text: Star Start could get an uncontested lead that becomes impossible to peg back if the field allows too much rope early
We've Got This returning from 222 days off but David Allan's booking and excellent distance record suggest readiness
Volenti's 7lb claiming jockey Harry Vigors faces a tactical challenge given the horse's need for cover in the early stages
Boubyan showed improved form before his break and Kevin Stott's presence suggests Michael Appleby expects a bold show
The weight differential between top-weighted We've Got This (135lbs) and Rajawail (116lbs) could prove significant in a slowly-run race
